brief.headline: Push Huhtamaki's laminate price down to ₹250/kg — the market-fair level and what we pay Silk Polypack — to cut our ₹58850 yearly excess

priceAsk.summary: Ask Huhtamaki to match ₹250/kg for laminate, in line with the market-fair band and our best current price
priceAsk.target: ₹250.00/KG (our current best price from Silk Polypack; market-fair band is ₹205–305/kg)
priceAsk.basis: We pay Huhtamaki ₹1067.36/KG — 326.9% more than the ₹250.00/KG Silk Polypack charges us. The market-fair band for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, and import unit value for BOPET film is 171.60 ₹/kg. Our ₹250 target sits at the top of the fair band and closes our ₹58850 annual excess.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days sooner (15 days after receipt instead of 30) in return for a further price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier frees up ₹3158 in cash for us — use that as the size of the price cut we ask for in return

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki is a ₹2755.75 Cr company — huge next to our ₹76850 spend (0.00% of their sales). They keep about ₹5 of every ₹100 they sell (4.7%) and carry very little debt (0.11x), so they're financially healthy but our order is too small to matter much on its own. They're growing fast (23.1%/yr), so they want new volume — bundle more items or commit a multi-year contract to get leverage, and line up UFLEX or Constantia Parikh as a second source to show you can walk.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant (₹16492.00 Cr) who makes both film and converts laminates — can handle our full volume and is already qualified as a second source for laminates

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, specializes in pharma blister and sachet laminates (₹222.04 Cr) — a strong proven second source for our laminate sachets

risks: Our spend is so small (0.00% of their sales) that Huhtamaki may not move much on price unless we bundle more volume or commit longer term
Huhtamaki's health score is C (58/100) — mid-tier — so they're stable but not top-tier; watch delivery and quality if you squeeze too hard
We already buy from them at a huge premium, so they know we've accepted ₹1067.36/KG before — be ready for pushback that our spec or service level justifies the gap
Silk Polypack at ₹250/KG is unaudited as a laminate supplier in DATA — verify their quality and capacity before using them as the sole benchmark in the room
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to keep working with you, but we're paying ₹1067 per kilo when the market-fair band for this laminate is ₹205–305 and our best price elsewhere is ₹250 — help us understand the gap and what it would take to get closer to ₹250.
